channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mario Chalmers | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mario Chalmers from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on LeBron James, Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Thompson said via The Volume.

“Mario Chalmers, at one point you were probably texting LeBron to get on a team and get a job. Listen, I’m just assuming. I’m just saying, just because you didn’t get your way, how could you say that about a guy who you went to war with, who believed in you. Then you’re going to come and say no one fears LeBron. This is the best player you’ve ever been on the court with.”

Tristan Thompson on LeBron James, Mario Chalmers, Mar 25, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers:

“I would've liked to have gotten him in tonight. I know he was itching to get in, he's a competitor. It didn't happen tonight, but it very well could at some point on this road trip.”

Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers, Jan 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers:

“He was ready to go and got on a flight pretty quickly. Just having him around today is like going back in time.”

Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers, Dec 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: David Fizdale on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Grizzlies coach David Fizdale:

“We didn’t deserve to win the game. We didn’t deserve to win the game. Our huddles were a joke tonight. Our communication was ridiculous. No one owned anything tonight. Mario Chalmers made a ridiculous play. I don’t really need to go too deep into that, and he heard it from, and he understands that. In the heat of the moment, he couldn’t own it. And that’s exactly what I meant. Twenty-five-thousand people was in here and saw that was the most ridiculous play of the whole game. But because of his brain was gone, he couldn’t just own it that it was a bonehead play.”

David Fizdale on Mario Chalmers, Nov 2, 2017. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Brandon Rush on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
“This is a big, big deal to have your number retired in the rafters of the Fieldhouse. There are some greats up there. My former teammate, Mario (Chalmers) is up there. It is a good feeling to know you will have your name up there.”

Brandon Rush on Mario Chalmers, Jan 7, 2017. Source: KUAthletics.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Erik Spoelstra on Chalmers' success in Memphis:

“You build friendships... I care very much about Rio and I want him to do well.”

Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers, Nov 17, 2015. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.

item.title: Chris Bosh on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Miami, on the tail end of a back-to-back, was without Dwyane Wade (hamstring), Luol Deng (wrist) and Josh McRoberts (foot).

“We’re going to put the ball in [Chalmers’] hands sometimes, especially late in the game and especially with guys out. We were relying on him a bit and he came through,”

Chris Bosh on Mario Chalmers, Nov 18, 2014. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Jeff Zillgitt:Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers:

“We have trust in Rio. I don't want him to shoulder the responsibility. It's a team game.”

Erik Spoelstra on Mario Chalmers, Jun 11, 2014. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: LeBron James on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:LeBron:

“I would hope [his contract situation isn’t affecting him], but I'm not Mario Chalmers and I'm not sure what goes through his mind.”

LeBron James on Mario Chalmers, Jun 11, 2014. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: LeBron James on Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:LeBron on Chalmers:

“Maybe I need to get on him the way I did in the past.”

LeBron James on Mario Chalmers, Jun 11, 2014. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Ray Allen on Mario Chalmers, Chris Andersen
item.description:
Ray Allen:

“Dwyane doesn't eat any vegetables, no greens, no salad, no nothing. Chris Andersen , it is all one tattoo, believe it or not. Mario Chalmers and I grew up together. I've known him since he was a little kid. Our fathers served in the military together.”

Ray Allen on Mario Chalmers, Chris Andersen, Mar 13, 2013. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Chris Bosh on James Jones, Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Chris Bosh:

“I’m sure I’ll be playing a lot more five. It’s kind of cool because I can say, ‘I’m the starting center for NBA champions.’’’ When Bosh said, that he changed his voice in a funny mannerHeat held team a party Sunday with James Jones as roast-master. Jones' zingers for Mario Chalmers included:”

Chris Bosh on James Jones, Mario Chalmers, Jun 25, 2012. Source: Sulia.
